name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Questions (o-questions)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-questions markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Questions (o-questions)

Record and read questions only through mtm: the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `questions.question ...`) or, without MCP, the mtm CLI (`mtm questions question ...`). Do not call the `o-questions` binary or another MCP server directly. Never put secrets in a question, answer, tag or link.

The owner's own questions. When the owner asks you something (they want to know, not to have something done), record it with `questions.question ask` (`mtm questions question ask WORDS`), using the owner's words exactly as typed. After you answer, record the answer with `questions.question answer` (the full answer, or a faithful summary with links to anything longer). Put a follow-up in the same thread with `questions.question follow-up`. Record only questions from the owner's own messages, not from a brief another agent sent you and not your own questions to the owner.

Decisions you need from the owner. Record each with `questions.question pose` (`mtm questions question pose`), with your recommendation (`recommendation`, and a stable `key` so posing again keeps the decision). The owner answers on the Review page. Read decisions with `questions.question decisions`, answer the owner's asks with `questions.question reply`, and after acting on a decision record it with `questions.question applied`. Do not ask for decisions in chat when o-questions is available.
